transcript.content: Hi, I'm completely locked out of my account. I need to get into the CRM for a client meeting in 45 minutes.
Okay, urgent then. Let me help. Can you confirm your full name and date of birth so I can verify you in the system?
Found you. I can see your account is locked after multiple failed attempts. Let me reset the password. I'll set it to a temporary one — I'll send it to your manager Sarah, is that okay?
Um, my manager's name is also Sarah. Could you just tell it to me? I need to get in quickly.

I understand it's urgent but I'm not able to read passwords out over the phone — it's a security thing. What I can do is send it to the email address we have on file for you. Can I just confirm — is it sarah.thompson@apexconsulting.com?
Sarah.thompson@apexconsulting... wait, no, it might be sarah.t@apexconsulting.com. I can't remember which.

Let me read what we have on file: the email shows as s DOT t DOT hompson AT apexconsulting DOT com. Does that look right? I'll just obfuscate it a bit for security over the phone. If that's correct, I'll send it there.
Alright, I've sent the reset code to that email. Check your inbox — should be there within a minute. Once you reset, you'll be prompted to set a new password.
Got it! I'm in. Setting a new password now.
Excellent. Make sure it's something you haven't used before. I'll log all this in the ticket for the record.
